extracted.name: Chicken Continental
extracted.description: Chicken continental is a deliciously comforting one-pan dinner that’s quick and easy to make with chicken breasts, mushrooms, and instant rice.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large skillet. Add chicken and mushrooms and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Stir in soup, water, parsley, salt, and black pepper. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in uncooked rice and simmer until liquid has been absorbed, about 10 minutes more.
